versions.note: New for round 7: the dorm courtyard and east lane, where day 1 spends its outdoor time without a track of its own
versions.prompt: Quiet residential feel for a dorm courtyard and a small lane: clean electric piano, nylon guitar, soft bass and a muted drum loop, a little lo-fi warmth, 88 BPM. Homely and relaxed, a melody that wanders and changes. Relaxed everyday background music for a slice-of-life video game, instrumental only, no vocals. No strings section, no orchestra, nothing epic or dramatic, no big build-up or climax. No ending: it keeps the same calm level to the end so it can loop.
versions.use: The dorm courtyard and the east lane.

versions.note: Round 7 feedback on dorms-lyria-2 ("not bad, very close, think the electric piano takes too much attention"): one change, the electric piano pulled back to quiet supporting chords and the nylon guitar on the melody; the rest of v1 kept word for word. Seed 7912 first, the seed of dorms-lyria-2.

Homely and relaxed, a melody that wanders and changes. Relaxed everyday background music for a slice-of-life video game, instrumental only, no vocals. No strings section, no orchestra, nothing epic or dramatic, no big build-up or climax. No ending: it keeps the same calm level to the end so it can loop.
versions.use: The dorm courtyard and the east lane.
